wargear.name: Icon of the Word
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with an Icon of the Word has the Fear (1) Special Rule and adds 1 to its Charge Rolls.
wargear.summary: A reliquary-banner scrolled with the Lectitio Divinitatus, carried at the head of the line.

wargear.name: Censer of Ruin
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Censer of Ruin has the Fear (1) Special Rule and subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.
wargear.summary: A swinging brazier of smoking ash and sacred oils whose stink unmans those who breathe it.

wargear.name: Possession-brand
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Possession-brand has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.
wargear.summary: A ritual scar-pattern that lets the thing within the armour take the blow in the warrior's place.

wargear.name: Cant-scroll
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Cant-scroll has the Marching Hymn Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A tattered hymn-roll chanted on the march.

wargear.name: Anathemata reliquary
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Anathemata reliquary has the Faith-Warded Mind Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A sealed casket of scripture and saints' bone.

wargear.name: Banner of the Pilgrim Host
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Banner of the Pilgrim Host has the Pilgrim's Cry Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A wide banner stitched with a thousand names.

wargear.name: Unction-sealed plating
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Unction-sealed plating has the Anointed Hull Special Rule.
wargear.summary: Hull plates washed in consecrated oils and cinders.

wargear.name: Dirge-horn siren
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Dirge-horn siren has the Siren Wail Special Rule and the Fear (1) Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A mournful chorus-siren bolted to the hull.

wargear.name: Pact-forged knife
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Pact-forged knife has the Sacrificial Blade Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A black knife bearing a name no mortal should speak.

wargear.name: Rite-book of Colchis
wargear.summary: A battered book of sermons, annotated in his own hand.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Rite-book of Colchis has the Sermon of Retribution Special Rule.

wargear.name: Gilded pectoral of the First Temple
wargear.summary: A breastplate beaten from the temple's own gold, heavy with prayer.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Gilded pectoral of the First Temple has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule and adds 1 to its Focus Roll when Engaged in a Challenge.

modifiers.text: Gilded pectoral of the First Temple: Feel No Pain (6+).

rites.name: Unyielding Faith
rites.flavor: A Legion that believes cannot be convinced to leave the field.
benefits: Every non-vehicle unit counts as having one additional Model for the purposes of determining Tactical Strength when it is counted for Controlling an Objective.
Chaplains and Diabolists gain Litany of Resolve: friendly units within 12" add 1 to their Leadership and Cool when making Leadership Checks and Cool Checks.
limitations: At least two Chaplains or Diabolists must be in the army.
No Techmarines, Forge Lords, Thallax, Castellax, Domitar, Thanatar, Vorax or Vultarax.

require.note: At least two Chaplains or Diabolists lead the faithful.

rites.name: The Possessed Host
rites.flavor: The Legion swore it would never take the warp as a weapon. Then it did.
benefits: Gal Vorbak Dark Brethren may fill Troops slots.
Gal Vorbak gain Daemonic Vessels: on a turn they Charge, the Breaching (6+) on their Tainted Talons becomes Breaching (5+) in that Combat.
limitations: At least one Gal Vorbak unit is required, and Gal Vorbak units must charge the closest enemy unit they can reach.
No model with the Psyker Trait, and no Armour units.

require.note: Bring at least one Gal Vorbak unit.

rites.name: Sermon from the Sky
rites.flavor: The preachers come down with fire in their fists and a verse already on their lips.
benefits: Ashen Circle may fill Troops slots.

Ashen Circle and Assault Squads gain Descent of the Preachers: on the turn they arrive by Deep Strike they gain Fear (1) and add +1 to the Hit Tests of their Shooting Attacks until the end of that turn.
limitations: Every Ashen Circle and Assault Squad must start the battle in Reserve, and at least one Ashen Circle is required.
No Recon, Armour, Support or Heavy Transport units.

modifiers.text: Sermon from the Sky: Descent of the Preachers.

require.note: Bring at least one Ashen Circle.

rites.name: The Indoctrinated Tide
rites.flavor: Every world conquered leaves ten thousand new converts to feed the next.
benefits: Inductii Squads gain Line (1) and Tide of Converts: a squad with ten or more models counts as having three additional Models for Tactical Strength when Controlling an Objective.
limitations: At least two Inductii Squads are required.
No Veteran, Terminator or Breacher squads.

modifiers.text: The Indoctrinated Tide: Tide of Converts, Line (1).

rules.name: Litany of Resolve
rules.text: While a friendly Word Bearers Unit is within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, each Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic and 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making Leadership Checks and Cool Checks.
rules.summary: The chaplain's voice carries over the guns and the dying.

rules.name: Daemonic Vessels
rules.text: In any Combat in which its Unit made a Charge during the current Battle Turn, a Model with this Special Rule treats the Breaching (6+) Special Rule on its Tainted Talons as Breaching (5+). A Unit made up of Models with this Special Rule must declare a Charge against the closest enemy Unit it is able to Charge whenever it can.
rules.summary: The thing within the armour wants the kill more than the warrior does.

rules.name: Descent of the Preachers
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule that arrives by Deep Strike has the Fear (1) Special Rule and adds 1 to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks until the end of the Battle Turn in which it arrives.
rules.summary: The preachers come down with fire in their fists and a verse already on their lips.

rules.name: Tide of Converts
rules.text: While a Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule includes ten or more Models, it counts as having three additional Models for the purposes of determining Tactical Strength when it is counted for Controlling an Objective.
rules.summary: Every conquered world feeds ten thousand more converts to the line.

rules.name: Marching Hymn
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule Rushes, add 2" to the distance it may move.
rules.summary: A chanted hymn lengthens every stride.

rules.name: Faith-Warded Mind
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to the Willpower Characteristic of its Models when making Willpower Checks to resist an enemy Psychic attack.
rules.summary: Scripture and saints' bone harden the mind against the warp.

rules.name: Pilgrim's Cry
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Charge Rolls. Once per Battle, the Unit may ignore the effects of the Pinned Tactical Status until the end of the current Phase.
rules.summary: A thousand names stitched into cloth, and every one of them is shouting.

rules.name: Anointed Hull
rules.text: Once per Battle, a Vehicle with this Special Rule may discard one Glancing Hit inflicted on it.
rules.summary: Consecrated oils and cinders ward the plating against the killing blow.

rules.name: Siren Wail
rules.text: Enemy Units that have a Model within 12" of a Vehicle with this Special Rule cannot Rush towards that Vehicle.
rules.summary: A mournful chorus-siren that pins the enemy's nerve to the ground.

rules.name: Sacrificial Blade
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule removes an enemy Model as a Casualty in a Challenge, every friendly Unit within 12" adds 1 to its Combat Resolution Points until the end of that Battle Turn.
rules.summary: A life given to the thing in the knife buys courage for the line.

rules.name: Preacher of Colchis
rules.summary: He was gentle once, and his voice alone steadied a legion.
rules.text: Friendly Word Bearers Units within 6" of this Model ignore the effects of the Pinned Tactical Status. This Model subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Ascendant Aurelian
rules.summary: The god-bound thing he is becoming does not trouble to hide behind a face.
rules.text: At the start of the Fight Sub-Phase, each enemy Unit that is Locked in Combat with this Model must make a Cool Check, and a Unit that fails subtracts 1 from the Initiative Characteristic of its Models until the end of that Phase. This Model subtracts 1 from its Toughness Characteristic.

rules.name: Hierophant of the Lectitio
rules.summary: The words are written, and the enemy who hears them is already doubting.
rules.text: Enemy Models within 12" of this Model subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic when making Cool Checks. This Model subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic.

rules.name: Sermon of Retribution
rules.summary: A verse read aloud, and the Legion hears a grudge.
rules.text: Once per Battle, at the start of any Battle Turn, the Controlling Player may choose one friendly Word Bearers Unit within 12" of this Model. Until the end of that Battle Turn, the Unit has the Hatred (Loyalist) Special Rule.

armyRules.name: Zealot's Fervour
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic in any Battle Turn in which its Unit made a Charge.
drawbacks: Whenever it is able to, a Unit with this Special Rule must declare a Charge against the nearest enemy Unit.
armyRules.condition: on a turn the unit charges

armyRules.name: Voice of the Faithful
armyRules.flavor: A preacher's sermon steels the line.
benefits: A friendly Word Bearers Unit within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Combat Resolution Points in any Combat it is part of.
drawbacks: If a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a Casualty, every friendly Word Bearers Unit within 12" must pass a Cool Check or gain the Suppressed Status.

armyRules.name: Blood-Price of the Pact
armyRules.flavor: The thing bound within takes its tithe.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic.
drawbacks: At the start of each of its Controlling Player's Battle Turns from the third, roll a D6 for each Unit with this Special Rule: on a 1, the Unit suffers 1 Wound, and no Saving Throws or Damage Mitigation Tests may be made against it.

armyRules.name: The Word Made Flesh
armyRules.flavor: Where the Word is spoken by its own author, no Legionary dares to doubt it.
benefits: While Lorgar Aurelian is on the battlefield, each friendly Word Bearers Unit within 12" of him scores 1 additional Combat Resolution point in the Resolution Sub-Phase of any Combat it is part of.
drawbacks: If Lorgar Aurelian is removed as a casualty, friendly Word Bearers Units no longer score Combat Resolution points from Unwavering Conviction or from this rule for the remainder of the Battle.
